question: Name one feature added in the latest Autodesk Fusion update.
answer:
Based on Autodesk Fusion's October 2026 major update, with the latest minor update being v.2706.1.17 (October 28, 2026) [1].

One feature added is automatic Zone and Sheet tracking in Drawings Revision History tables. You enable **Auto-update Zone** and **Auto-update Sheet** in the Revision History dialog, and Fusion populates those columns from each revision marker's placement and sheet, updating as markers are added, moved, or deleted [1].

Other additions in this update include AI-assisted Auto Timeline, which converts imported non-native geometry into an editable parametric design [5], and built-in task management with Kanban or list views [1][5].

keyPoints.text: The October 2026 Fusion major update adds Auto Timeline, which uses AI-assisted feature reconstruction to turn imported non-native geometry into an editable parametric design.
The October 2026 update also adds Autodesk System Modeler, a node-based no-code automation environment for design and manufacturing tasks.
The October 2026 update adds built-in task management with Kanban and list views inside Fusion.
The latest minor update, v.2706.1.17 dated October 28, 2026, contains only stability and bug fixes.
